run_reconstruction: run the local TensoRF reconstruction pipeline with pose optimization and progressive refinement
render_test_frames: render test frames from a trained checkpoint using the render_test function
render_smooth_path: render a smooth spline camera path from poses using the render_frames function
save_transforms_json: save camera poses and intrinsics to a transforms.json file using save_transforms
run_cli_entry: run the train.py CLI entry point to start reconstruction or rendering via config_parser
